LanguageData.DMS_MechLink.label: Cluster transceiver
LanguageData.DMS_MechLink.description: A man-made bionic implant that allows direct control of mechanoids. No one knows whether it is an early form of the mechlink or a reverse-engineered product of later generations; either way, it fills the role of a mechlink at a technical level that rimworld humans can understand and imitate.\n\nDue to machining precision and installation conditions, installing these imitations often comes with side effects.
LanguageData.DMS_MechLink_Nerfed.label: Boid Controller
LanguageData.DMS_MechLink_Nerfed.description: A low-tech makeshift mechlink, usually issued to non-conscript soldiers and makeshift frontline mechanitors. Once installed it lets the implantee serve as a mechanitor for the duration of the safety protocol.\n\nDue to machining precision and installation conditions, installing these imitations often comes with side effects.
LanguageData.DMS_MechLink_Nerfed.comps.CompUsableImpl: Install {0_label} to become a temporary mechanitor
